title: hotfix: stabilize SLO enforcer backoff and hysteresis during regional failover
author: Priya Kaur
release_notes: Fix SLO enforcer thrashing during regional failover: ordering fixes for backoff evaluation, jittered exponential backoff, hysteresis window, improved metrics and emergency override.
description: Context: During a partial regional outage (2026-02-18) the SLO enforcer entered a thrashing state: per-region circuit-breaker backoffs were racing, which triggered repeated regional failovers and excessive load-shedding. This caused a spike in 5xxs and latency SLO violations for a subset of customers. Motivation: provide deterministic ordering for backoff state transitions, add hysteresis to avoid flip-flops, introduce jitter to prevent synchronized retries, and improve observability + an emergency override for on-call. Summary of changes: - Make backoff evaluation atomic: introduce a compare-and-swap style update path for per-region backoff state to remove race conditions. - Add hysteresis window (configurable) so a region that briefly recovers doesn't immediately clear the backoff until it sustains healthy metrics for the window. - Introduce per-region jittered exponential backoff with seeded randomness to avoid global synchronization. - Add metrics: slo_enforcer.backoff_state{region}, slo_enforcer.hysteresis_count, slo_enforcer.backoff_jitter_ms and tracing spans to track decision path. - Add integration tests that simulate regional instability and assert no thrashing and eventual recovery under expected conditions. - Add ops runbook with steps to apply emergency override and recommended thresholds. Checklist: - [x] Unit tests updated - [x] Integration test reproducing previous thrash pattern - [x] New metrics and dashboards (docs/ops updated) - [x] Add emergency override config and admin endpoint - [x] CI green (after a single rerun)
